source: User-authorized requirements relayed from Fix the wall guide (2), thread 01a14093-d3c7-78b1-9a29-43ea381a5a2a
requirements: Circular escutcheons only; constant visible border centered on the actual assembled decorative cover.
Main and diverter plates must have a positive gap without offsetting the circles from their covers.
Compare the ordinary circular aperture plate with an upper-only screw-locating version retaining metal at the actual trim studs.
Assess through-hole versus threaded engagement, insertion/removal, bearing, cover depth and factory sealing/service functions.
No tile drilling/cutting and no modification of factory holes. Lower companion remains circular.

reference_state.use: Separate derived tip-center state for diagnostic locator trials only; not physical calibration or accepted axis coordinates.
reference_state.projection_assumption: Trial stud axes normal to the tile plane, using fitted tip X/Y at every Z. Actual inclination and plate-plane centers unknown.

geometry_trial.parameter_status: All tab/hole/slot sizes are exploratory design parameters, not measured fastener dimensions or released tolerances.
geometry_trial.bearing_status: Actual nuts/washers, diameter, seating, material strength and clamping load unknown. No bearing approval.

threaded_engagement: Not selected: thread identity, usable engagement, clamping stack and serviceable assembly method are unverified. Clearance capture is studied first.
insertion_methods_to_compare: Integral flat tabs: must clear the complete forward hardware sweep while sliding toward the wall.
Removable bridges: can be fitted after the open plate, but still need final seated clearance, retention, cover cavity and seal-land checks. No new attachment holes selected.
release: No locating variant may be quoted as viable until insertion, seated clearance, actual axes, bearing and cover/foam interaction are resolved.
